name: parts-inventory-system
description: PARTS INVENTORY SYSTEM - Dealer Part Inventory Management SaaS

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n DB,API,WEB -c green,blue,magenta "npm run db:studio -w database" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w database && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
